reviews.title: Disappointing Experience With Arvin AI for Reselling Workflow
reviews.text:
At first, after seeing ads for Arvin AI on Facebook, I was genuinely excited because the app looked very promising. After downloading it, I realized you have to purchase the Pro version immediately without even being able to properly test it first. The pricing was actually pretty reasonable compared to some other AI photo editing apps, so I decided to give it a try anyway.

Unfortunately, the actual performance was disappointing. As a reseller, my main focus is simple tasks like background removal and background replacement. The most important thing for this kind of work is processing speed. I’m not looking for anything overly advanced or complicated. Even a simple clean white studio background with a natural shadow would be perfectly fine for my needs.

The problem is that even generating a very basic background takes an extremely long time. 10 - 15 seconds per image for something this simple is just not practical. When you work with hundreds, sometimes even over a thousand photos a day, speed matters more than fancy AI features. At the current performance level, the workflow becomes frustrating and unrealistic for high volume sellers.

Another issue is the lack of organization features. There’s no option to favorite or pin the backgrounds you like and use often, so every single time you have to scroll all over again from the beginning just to find the same styles. That becomes extremely inconvenient during repetitive work.

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text:
I am very dissatisfied with the latest update of the Arvin app. I am a Premium subscriber and I pay to use this service, so I expect improvements with each update. Unfortunately, with every new update the results seem to get worse rather than better.

The recent updates make significant changes to the main image, and the final result often looks very artificial and no longer resembles my original product. This is extremely frustrating, especially when accuracy and realism are important for my work.

As a paying user, I hope you seriously review these changes and improve the image processing so that the results remain closer to the original product and look more natural
